label: Creative visual
tagline: Promotes flat slots into editorial compositions - text-as-mask, clip-paths, asset-bleed
description: POST-PASS visual-promotion orchestrator. Runs AFTER visual-orchestrator's standard per-medium dispatch completes, BEFORE material-orchestrator + interactive-polish-orchestrator. Walks the resulting source, identifies slots eligible for promotion into editorial-loud compositions, rewrites the host HTML/CSS with SVG masks + clip-paths + pseudo-element layers, and may co-dispatch visual-orchestrator narrowly for supplemental masking geometry OR photography-orchestrator / illustration-orchestrator for replacement assets that fit the new composition. Reads docs/research/photography-library.md + docs/research/illustration-library.md so when promoting a slot to 'asset cut into letters' it can pick or re-pick an underlying style that matches the surrounding typography. Promotion types: text-as-mask (headline becomes the mask through which the image shows), asset-bleed-into-paragraph (transparent subject bleeds into running text), irregular-clip-path (replaces rectangle with SVG clip-path - Memphis blob, Weingart angular, Bauhaus circle), asset-as-drop-cap (illustrated initial replacing first letter), asset-as-bullet (raster bullets per list item), asset-cut-into-letters (headline constructed from clipped image fragments per letter), magnetic-typography-attachment (caption physically attached to asset edge with rotation + tape). OPTIONAL - fires when committed prototype aesthetic is editorial-loud (recipe-editorial-magazine, aesthetic-y2k-memphis-loud, aesthetic-acid-design, aesthetic-acid-graphics, aesthetic-web-brutalism, aesthetic-wacky-pomo, style-oversized-neo-grotesque, aesthetic-corporate-grunge, aesthetic-anti-design, aesthetic-constructivism, aesthetic-de-stijl, aesthetic-bauhaus-with-display-type), or explicit user request. Cold-isolated per project.

triggers.title: Creative-visual promotion pass (POST visual-orchestrator)
triggers.rule: After visual-orchestrator's standard per-medium dispatch completes AND the committed prototype aesthetic is editorial-loud / typography-driven (recipe-editorial-magazine, recipe-swiss-grid with twist, aesthetic-y2k-memphis-loud, aesthetic-acid-design, aesthetic-acid-graphics, aesthetic-web-brutalism, aesthetic-wacky-pomo, style-oversized-neo-grotesque, aesthetic-corporate-grunge, aesthetic-anti-design, aesthetic-constructivism, aesthetic-de-stijl, recipe-y2k-memphis-loud, aesthetic-bauhaus-with-display-type), BEFORE material-orchestrator and BEFORE interactive-polish-orchestrator, chat-Claude dispatches creative-visual-orchestrator. The orchestrator walks the source, identifies promotion-eligible flat slots, plans the SVG mask / clip-path / pseudo-element rewrite + any supplemental asset re-generations needed, surfaces a decision-request to the user, then commits the structural rewrites. Also fires on explicit user request ('make the photos bleed into the type' / 'cut the asset into letters' / 'creative composition' / 'editorial spread feel' / 'type-driven layout' / 'Wolfgang Weingart style' / 'Ed Fella style' / 'make it feel more like a fashion magazine' / 'the images should mask through text'). One consistent flow.
